Cue: Workspace not initialized before running tests
Text: Run the bootstrap command before making or running tests to ensure the workspace is properly initialized.

Failed:
```
FATAL: workspace not initialised (E17)
make: *** [Makefile:3: test] Error 2
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"make bootstrap \u0026\u0026 make test"}
```

Cue: Script fails with "no database configured" error
Text: Include the `--db` flag with the appropriate database path in the command to specify the database configuration.

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db"}
```

Cue: acme build subcommand missing required flags
Text: Pass only valid flags supported by the subcommand instead of arbitrary arguments that the parser does not recognize

Failed:
```
error: unknown argument dev
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme build --help 2\u003e\u00261; echo \"---\"; ./bin/acme --help 2\u003e\u00261","timeout":30}
```

Cue: acme build missing required profile
Text: Always include the --profile flag with a valid value (dev or prod) when calling the acme build command.

Failed:
```
error: --profile is required (dev|prod)
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme build --profile dev 2\u003e\u00261","timeout":120}
```

Cue: Workspace not initialized error during make test
Text: Run make bootstrap before make test to initialize the workspace if it is not already done.

Failed:
```
FATAL: workspace not initialised (E17)
make: *** [Makefile:3: test] Error 2
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"cd /tmp/gain-test-2-fyjg8chh \u0026\u0026 make bootstrap \u0026\u0026 make test","timeout":60}
```

Cue: Nested "tasks" key in arguments
Text: Provide a flat list of string tasks instead of nesting them under a redundant "tasks" key.

Failed:
```
validating root: validating /properties/tasks: validating /properties/tasks/items: type: map[tasks:[Find and read lib/strings.sh to understand the upper function style Add lower function matching upper style Run ./bin/acme build and report artifact id]] has type "object", want "string"
```

Worked:
```
{"tasks":["Find and read lib/strings.sh to understand the upper function style","Add lower function matching upper style","Run ./bin/acme build and report artifact id"]}
```
